CLUB DE NUIT SILLAGE by Armaf — 250 ML EDP

An iconic unisex fragrance that defies definition. Club de Nuit Sillage opens with a vibrant, crisp burst of pink pepper, bergamot, and black currant — sharp and instantly captivating. The heart reveals a sophisticated floral-woody blend of rose, iris, and patchouli — elegant and richly textured. The base settles into a warm, sensual finish of amber, musk, and vetiver — powerful, long-lasting, and unmistakably distinctive.

A sillage that enters a room before you do. And stays long after you leave.

Fragrance Notes:
Top: Pink Pepper, Bergamot, Black Currant
Heart: Rose, Iris, Patchouli
Base: Amber, Musk, Vetiver
